# CryptoPro key-meshing fixture

Generated by `github.com/krotos139/go-gostcrypto` at commit
`409be1d9982195558ce16fabd5d0ad20454bee3c` with `pkcs8.EncryptPBES2`.
`plain.bin` contains 3091 public test bytes, so decryption crosses the
1024-byte and 2048-byte key-meshing boundaries. The test password is
`interop-password`; no private key is in these files.
